[[Flight leader/Legends|Flight Leader]] '''Wilkins''' was a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the ranks of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

His astromech droid was [[BXET-R2]].

==Biography==
Wilkins was involved in an [[Battle of the Vehemence|assault]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vehemence (Star Destroyer)|''Vehemence'']] when a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] collided with his Y-wing. Wilkins was blinded, and it was due to the actions of BXET-R2 that Wilkins and his Y-wing were able to [[Hyperspace/Legends|escape]] the battle.
